bagPolicy.summary: No bag size limit is published, but backpacks are prohibited. Coat check takes coats and bags, with no rechecks, so grab what you need before you drop your items.
bagPolicy.quote: No rechecks, so make sure you have everything you need when you drop off your item.

parking.summary: Parking is available in front of the club and on surrounding streets. Two pay-to-park lots are also one block northwest of the club.
parking.quote: Two pay-to-park lots are located one block NW of the club as well.

rideshare.summary: El Corazon suggests Uber or Lyft for getting around Seattle, and there's a bus stop across the street. No dedicated pickup zone is published, so set your pickup to the venue's address.
rideshare.quote: Download Uber or Lyft on your smartphone to get around Seattle with ease.

concessions.summary: No outside food or drink is allowed into The Funhouse or El Corazon, including water bottles. Bars inside the club serve draft and bottled beer.
concessions.quote: No outside food or drink is allowed into the Funhouse or El Corazon.

accessibility.summary: Call 206-262-0482 or email info@elcorazonseattle.com ahead of time so staff can make arrangements. Animals aren't allowed, except certified guide dogs.
accessibility.quote: Please call ahead to 206-262-0482 or email info@elcorazonseattle.com so we can make arrangements.

reEntry.summary: Guests 21 and over can leave and come back in. Re-entry isn't allowed for guests under 21.
reEntry.quote: Re-entry is permitted for patrons over the age of 21.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday through Friday from 1 to 6 pm, so call 206-262-0482 when you arrive, and it doesn't take phone orders. Only guests 21 and over may enter alcohol service areas, and IDs must show date of birth, signature, photo and expiration date.
ticketPickup.quote: Monday – Friday from 1-6pm. Call 206-262-0482 when you arrive.

gates.summary: For door times, call 206-262-0482 or check the El Corazon website. Security staff are at all entrances and exits, and arriving early helps you get a good view.
gates.quote: For information on door times please call 206-262-0482 or visit www.elcorazonseattle.com.
